purpose: Offline analysis of preserved attempt4 evidence; no public run or DB write
interpretation: Run pause and newer revision predate rejection; blocking authority is consistent with the approved guard.
finish_claim resets attempts to zero; terminal attempts cannot establish absence of previous deferrals.
claim_revision is monotonic fencing metadata; the saved terminal snapshot lacks the claim start/end/due transitions needed to reconstruct each claim.
serve schedules protection and manual phases before the bot-order phase. The 20ms outer sleep is not an upper bound on dispatch latency.
defer_claim has bounded 1s/5s/30s/5min schedules, but no preserved per-claim evidence proves which delay contributed to this command.
Risk DATABASE_TIMEOUT and book readiness warnings have no per-command phase timestamps in the preserved log; they do not establish the latency root cause.
next_diagnostic_if_separately_authorized: Capture monotonic phase durations and safe command/claim correlation at selection, claim commit, process start, defer/terminal commit; preserve source/risk readiness at each boundary. Do not log secrets or change trading guards.
